t: You're standing at 54 and 55 Cornhill, a building in the City of London. It was designed by Ernest Augustus Runtz, an English architect who lived from 1859 to 1913. Runtz is best known for his work on theatres, particularly in London, so it's interesting to see his name attached to a building on a City street like this. I don't have much more to say about the building itself, so take a look at the frontage.
